evidence.note: DeepPrune identifies inter-trace redundancy in parallel test-time scaling (over 80% of parallel reasoning traces yield identical final answers) and trains a specialized judge model to predict answer equivalence from unfinished trace pairs, combined with online greedy clustering to prune redundant paths during generation, cutting token consumption 65.7-88.5% versus consensus sampling with accuracy within 3 percentage points.
evidence.title: DeepPrune: Parallel Scaling without Inter-trace Redundancy
